trg: Bakolinga koyeba esika azwaki potomone wana mpe mpo na nini ezali na maboko na ye.

src: If the person cannot provide a satisfactory explanation, he may be arrested and charged with theft.
trg: Soki moto wana akoki te kopesa ndimbola ebongi, bakoki kokanga ye mpe koloba ete ayibaki.

src: If the person is arrested, he will be taken to jail and held until his trial.
trg: Soki bakangi moto wana, bakomema ye na boloko mpe akozala kuna kino bakosambisa ye.

src: At his trial, the prosecution will have to prove beyond a reasonable doubt that he is guilty of theft.
trg: Na lisambisi wana, makambo bafundi ye ezali komonisa polele ete ayibaki mpenza.

src: The defense will have the opportunity to present evidence and witnesses that may help to exonerate the person.
trg: Bato bazali kosamba bakozala na libaku ya kopesa bilembeteli mpe kobimisa batatoli oyo bakokisa kosalisa na kolongola moto wana na ngambo.

src: If the person is found guilty, he may be sentenced to jail time, probation, or community service.
trg: Soki bamoni ete moto wana azali na ngambo, bakoki kokatela ye etumbu ya boloko, akotsa mibeko moko boye, to asala misala na lisanga.

src: He may also be ordered to pay restitution to the victim of the theft.
trg: Bakoki mpe kosenga ye azongisela moto oyo ye ayibaka biloko oyo ayibaki.

src: In some cases, the person may be able to avoid criminal charges by entering into a diversion program.
trg: Na bandakisa mosusu, moto akoki kokima bitumba ya crime na kokotaka na programe ya bokeseni.

src: Diversion programs are designed to help people who have committed minor crimes avoid the criminal justice system.
trg: Basala baprograme ya bokeseni mpo na kosalisa bato oyo basali mbeba ya mike na kokota te na ebongiseli ya bosambisi ya ba crime.

src: In a diversion program, the person may be required to complete community service, pay restitution, or attend counseling.
trg: Na programe ya bokeseni, bakoki kosenga moto na kosala misala mpo na lisanga, kofuta biloko ayibaki, to kozwa batoli.

src: If the person is found not guilty, he will be released from jail and the charges against him will be dropped.
trg: Soki bamoni ete moto wana azali na ngambo te, bakobimisa ye na boloko mpe balongola makambo bafundaki ye.

src: He will be able to go on with his life without a criminal record.
trg: Akokoba kozala na bomoi kozanga kozala na dosie ya ba crime.

src: It is important to note that the above is just a general overview of what may happen to a presumed thief who is held by police.
trg: Ezali ntina koyeba ete makambo tolobi na likolo ezali kaka bokuse ya makambo oyo ekoki kosalema na moto oyo bakanisi ete ayibi oyo polisi ekangi.

src: The specific circumstances of each case will vary, and the outcome may depend on a number of factors, such as the evidence available, the person's criminal history, and the judge or jury's decision.
trg: Makambo etali likambo mokomoko ekokesana, mpe mbano ekoki kotalela makambo ebele, neti bilembeteli oyo ezali, lisolo ya ba crime ya moto wana, mpe ekateli ya zuzi to ya bato oyo bazali kosambisa.

src: Hockey is a fast-paced, physical sport that is played on ice.
trg: Hockey ezali lisano ya mbango mpe esengaka makasi ya nzoto, babetaka yango na glase.

src: It is played with two teams of six players each, with one goaltender.
trg: Ebetamaka na baekipe mibale ya ba joueur motoba na ekipe mokomoko, na gardien.

src: The object of the game is to score goals by shooting the puck into the opponent's net.
trg: Mokano ya lisano ezali ya kotya minkete ebele na kobetaka palet na monyama ya monguna.

src: Hockey is a popular sport in Canada, the United States, and Europe.
trg: Hockey ezali lisano eyebani na Canada, na États-Unis, mpe na Eropa.

trg: Ezali moko ya masano ya Olympique.

src: The influences of religion on music are vast and varied.
trg: Bopusi ya miziki na losambo ezali monene mpe ekeseni.

src: From the chanting of hymns in ancient temples to the soaring melodies of gospel songs, music has long been used to express religious beliefs and emotions.
trg: Banda na koyemba loyembo ya batempelo ya kala kino na banzembo ya nsango malamu, basalela miziki mpo na komonisa bindimeli mpe mayoki ya lingomba.

src: In many religions, music is seen as a way to connect with the divine.
trg: Na mangomba ebele, bamonaki miziki lokola lolenge ya koyokana na nzambe.

src: The sounds and rhythms of music can create a sense of awe and reverence, and can help to transport the listener to a higher plane of consciousness.
trg: Makelele mpe rythme ya miziki ekoki kopusa na kobanga mpe kotosa, mpe ekoki komema moyoki na esika ya likolo mpenza ya koyeba.

src: For example, in Hinduism, music is considered to be a form of yoga.
trg: Na ndakisa, na lingomba ya Hindu, bamonaka miziki lokola lolenge moko ya yoga.

src: The practice of kirtan, or devotional chanting, is said to help to purify the mind and open the heart to the divine.
trg: Balobaka ete kosla kirtan, to koyemba ya losambo, esalisaka na kopetolo makanisi mpe kofungolela nzambe motema.

src: In Buddhism, music is often used as a form of meditation, helping to focus the mind and bring about a state of calm and tranquility.
trg: Na lingomba ya Budha, mbala mingi basalelaka miziki lokola lolenge ya komanyola, kosalisa na kotya makanisi esika moko mpe komema kimya ya makasi.

src: In addition to its spiritual role, music can also be used to address social and political issues.
trg: Longola mosala na yango ya elimo, miziki ekoki kosalelama mpo na kolobela makambo ya bomoi mpe ya politiki.

src: In the civil rights movement, for example, music played a powerful role in mobilizing people and inspiring them to fight for justice.
trg: Na ndakisa, na mivema ya balotomo ya sivile miziki ezalaka na bopusi makasi mpo na kosangisa bato mpe kopusa bango na kobunda mpo na boyengebene.

src: The songs of Martin Luther King Jr, Mahalia Jackson, and others helped to give voice to the hopes and dreams of African Americans, and helped to bring about a more just and equitable society.
trg: Banzembo ya Martin Luther King Jr, Mahalia Jackson, mpi ya misusu esalisaka na kolobela bilikya mpe bandoto ya Bato ya Amerika bauta Afrika, mpe esalisaka na kozala na lisanga ya malamu mpe ya boyengebene.

src: Peacocks are also known for their elaborate courtship displays, which they perform to attract mates.
trg: Bapaon bayebana mpe mpo na makambo ebeleebele basalaka mpo na kolingana, basalaka yango mpo na kobenda balongani.

src: During these displays, the male peacock will spread his tail feathers and fan them out to create a large, colorful fan.
trg: Na ntango ya kosala yango, paon ya mobali apanzaka masala ya mokila na ye mpe abongisaka yango mpo na kosala ventilateur ya monene mpe ya langi ebele.

src: The female peacock will then choose a mate based on the size and beauty of his tail feathers.
trg: Na nsima paon ya mwasi akopona mobali na kotalela monene mpe kitoko ya masala ya mokila na ye.

src: Peacocks are also known for their intelligence and ability to learn.
trg: Bapaon eyebana mpe mpo na mayele mpe makoki na yango ya koyekola.

src: They can be trained to perform tricks and can even be taught to talk.
trg: Bakoki koteya yango na kosala biloko mpe bakoki koteya bango kutu na koloba.

src: In addition to their beauty and intelligence, peacocks are also important members of the ecosystem.
trg: Longola kitoko mpe mayele na bango, bapaon bazali mpe ntina mpo na mabele.

src: They help to control the population of insects and other pests, and their droppings can help to fertilize the soil.
trg: Basalisaka na kobatela banyama mike mpe tubanyama mosusu, mpe nyei na bango ekoki kosalisa mabele ebota biloko mingi.
